impact: Every synthesis run receives the updated PERSONA as both persona and playbook inputs. PLAYBOOK.md is never passed to Haiku. The playbook output of synthesis is written based on persona content, not playbook content — causing PLAYBOOK.md to gradually drift toward a persona echo instead of cross-session universal patterns. This silently breaks one of the three synthesis outputs from day one.
resolution: Changed `currentPlaybook: readPersona()` to `currentPlaybook: readPlaybook()` in the synthesize() call in src/server.ts (line 294). The typo caused every synthesis run to receive the current persona content in both the persona and playbook fields, so PLAYBOOK.md was never read or used as input. Now synthesis receives the actual PLAYBOOK.md content and can update it independently from the persona.
title: [bug] currentPlaybook: readPersona() — synthesis never sees the real PLAYBOOK.md
